setting.name: Kepler Station
setting.summary: A 200-person colony under a sealed dome. Everything the colonists breathe, eat and burn is made or recycled inside. Earth is a radio link and a supply ship away.

locations.greenhouse: Greenhouse Dome: crop racks under LED lamps. The main oxygen source.
locations.lifesupport: Life Support: oxygen tanks, CO2 scrubbers, air sensors.
locations.power: Power Plant: solar array and reactor. Every other location draws from it.
locations.clinic: Clinic: medical bay and the lab that runs tests.
locations.market: Market: where colonists trade rations, time and favours.
locations.mine: Mine: ice and metal extraction. Water comes from here.
locations.habitat: Habitat Ring: homes. Where daily life and rumours happen.
locations.council: Council Hall: where the colony makes shared decisions.
locations.comms: Comms Tower: the link to Earth. Real-world cases arrive here as 'archive transmissions'.

cast.role: Newly arrived colonist. Learns each model by using it.
Chief engineer. Asks 'what must be true?' Blunt, precise.
Veteran botanist, 12 years in the dome. Strong gut instincts, sometimes right.
Clinic doctor. Trusts data, distrusts anecdotes.
Mine foreman. Defends his crew's share of power and water.

crisis: Oxygen output from the Greenhouse Dome is falling about 1% a day, and the next supply ship has been delayed 90 days. The cause turns out to be a slow-spreading leaf blight made worse by a drifting lamp spectrum. Solving it takes every model in the pilot.

acts.title: The Spread
acts.question: What happens next if we act, or don't?

acts.title: The Colony Decides
acts.question: How do 200 people choose a future together?

ending: The final project: the council asks you to write the colony's 10-year plan, using at least five models by name.
